ns2:course.label: Surfaces and Colloids
ns2:course.description: Introduction to the chemistry and physics of surfaces and interfaces, with emphasis on behavior in liquid media. Four main areas are treated: (1) surface composition; (2) surface and interfacial forces; (3) colloidal stability and flocculation; (4) amphiphilic molecules. Same as CHEM 488. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 or 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: MSE 401.
